## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: **34 dishes, 5 Tunisia-only** (*lablabi*, *assidat zgougou*, *bambalouni*, *mechouia* salad, *tabil*); the rest shared (couscous, pastilla, sfenj, brik-like pastries, gazelle ankles). Ingredients only from the text description.
- [[ArabCulture]]: 261 items, **53 in the Food topic (27 Tunisia-specific)** + 6 food-adjacent; e.g. *ftayer* with honey, *bsissa* with dates or olive oil, *mloukhia* with bread, butter and *chamia* sandwiches.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 7 dishes (36 rows), e.g. *assidat zgougou*, *kefteji*, *kabkabou*, *mechouia*; ingredients, no amounts.
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 6 dishes, 2 Tunisia-only (Tunisian burek, *charmoula* with salted fish); ingredient lists for all.
- [[ArSyra Food and Culture]]: Tunisia claimed; counts unknown.
- No Tunisian label in [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]], [[RecipeDB2]] or [[BLEnD]].

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Tunisian FCT in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- [[CMAUP]]: 136 plants on the map (130 scraped). [[KNApSAcK Family]]: flag page, counts not scraped.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 15 concentration values, all organochlorine pesticide residues (p,p'-DDE, DDD, DDT) in breast milk from mothers in twelve regions (Ennaceur 2008): an exposure record, not a diet–health link.
- [[NPASS]]: 12 species–compound pairs. [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 5 records.
- Global backbone via [[Global]].

## Gaps
- No recipes with amounts, no FCT, and Tunisia is absent from BLEnD.
- Tunisian herbal medicine is essentially missing (5 Duke records).
